const raw=$('Normalize Form Response').first().json.intake; const crawl=$('Firecrawl - Get Crawl Status').first().json; const publicResults=$input.all().flatMap(item=>item.json.data?.web||item.json.web||item.json.data||[]); const allowed=['businessName','website','profileUrls','businessDescription','businessArea','challenge','currentSystems','currentSoftware','oneYearSuccess','solutionOutcome','budgetRange','timeline','automationWish']; const intake=Object.fromEntries(allowed.filter(k=>raw[k]!==undefined&&raw[k]!==null&&String(raw[k]).trim()).map(k=>[k,Array.isArray(raw[k])?raw[k].join(', '):String(raw[k]).slice(0,1000)])); const candidates=[...(crawl.data||crawl.pages||[]).map(p=>({sourceType:'website',sourceUrl:p.url||p.metadata?.sourceURL||p.metadata?.url,title:p.metadata?.title||p.title||'',content:p.markdown||p.content||''})),...publicResults.map(p=>({sourceType:'public_search',sourceUrl:p.url||p.metadata?.sourceURL||p.metadata?.url,title:p.metadata?.title||p.title||'',content:p.markdown||p.description||p.content||''}))]; const lineCounts=new Map(); for(const s of candidates)for(const l of String(s.content||'').split('

').map(l=>l.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()).filter(l=>{const k=l.toLowerCase();if(!l||repeated.has(k)||seenLines.has(k))return false;seenLines.add(k);return true;}).join('
').slice(0,3500,remaining);if(!content)continue;seenUrls.add(url);remaining-=content.length;sources.push({sourceType:s.sourceType,sourceUrl:url,title:String(s.title||'').slice(0,300),content});} console.log(JSON.stringify({event:'pluton.ai.evidence_packaged',sourceCount:sources.length,sourceCharacterCount:45000-remaining,hasBusinessName:Boolean(intake.businessName)}));return[{json:{intake,clientProvidedFacts:Object.entries(intake).map(([field,value])=>({field,value})),sources,sourceUrls:sources.map(s=>s.sourceUrl),researchMetadata:{websitePageLimit:20,publicSearchQueries:5,sourceCount:sources.length,sourceCharacterCount:45000-remaining,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()},aiAttempt:Number($json.aiAttempt||1)}}];

parameters.jsCode: const response=$input.first().json;const source=$('Clean and Package Evidence').first().json;const text=response.output_text||response.output?.flatMap(x=>x.content||[]).map(x=>x.text).filter(Boolean).join('')||response.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;let report;const errors=[];try{report=JSON.parse(text);}catch{errors.push('AI did not return valid JSON.');}const required=['prospectSummary','clientProvidedFacts','verifiedFindings','inferences','visibleInfrastructure','customerJourney','priorityOpportunities','missingInformation','discoveryCallQuestions','recommendedDemo','callStrategy'];const confidence=new Set(['high','medium','low']);const allowed=new Set(source.sourceUrls||[]);if(report){if(Object.keys(report).some(k=>!required.includes(k)))errors.push('Report contains unsupported
